title: 31 Out of 3,01,869 cases in which trials were completed, 62% ended in conviction. The highest percentage of conviction out of the cases in which trials were completed was noticed in thefts (73.6%) and it was the lowest for Riots (30.4%) while for all other crimes it varied approximately from 30% to 68%.
